component.name: Flux
component.summary: A local-first, native music player for your own library

description.p: Flux is a native desktop music player for local audio files. It manages a self-contained canonical library with stable artist, album, track and queue identities, managed artwork and lyrics, playlists, ratings and playback history.

Import review is offline and local: metadata comes from filenames, folders, existing library entities and local sidecar files. Flux does not read or rewrite audio tags, require an account, or contact a network service.
First release-engineering build with Linux packages, Windows and macOS bundle automation, native build identity, icons and checksums.
